headline: Lykos and Tempest See Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: The ledger’s latest turn brings Lykos Isle and Tempest Island sharply into the foreground. Lykos recorded seven strategic-base events in the past two hours and 22 across the day, with Fort Guile and The Squall each reporting 11; its holdings remain split four Colonial to three Warden. Tempest added four events in two hours and nine in 24, chiefly around Blackwatch, though its six-to-three Colonial majority is unchanged. Deadlands, the war’s great furnace, has also stirred with two fresh events and nine over the day, including six at The Salt March; ownership stands eight Colonial to three Warden. Godcrofts remains the busiest ledger over the full day, with 17 events, but none in the latest two hours and four in six. The Fingers and Farranac Coast show older movement, while Fisherman’s Row has no recent events despite nine in the daily record. Heavy casualty and enlistment surges at Clahstra, Kings Cage, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf mark serious activity, but no current base events there confirm an ownership turn.
